brief.subject: Interactive 3D Christmas globe
brief.sequence: Continuous falling snow, brief decaying oscillation with snow agitation, return to rest

assumptions.snow: Replace static snow sprites with continuously falling points.
assumptions.background: Dark pine to complement the existing red and gold model.

technology: Three.js with a single renderer loop and a procedural damped shake.

revision.brief: Remove button controls, move model to the bottom of the page, add snow effect for the whole page
revision.layout: Globe anchored to the bottom of the viewport
revision.permission: First globe activation requests permission where required

rotationRevision.brief: User should be able to rotate globe on desktop and mobile. Only horizontaly.

lightingRevision.brief: add more realistic light to the globe to improve 3D effect of the glass
lightingRevision.glass: Angle-dependent rim reflections with warm key and cool fill highlights

presentsRevision.brief: When globe shakes, move randomly presents inside.
presentsRevision.geometry: 10 matching box and ribbon vertex ranges in the existing GLB
presentsRevision.motion: Randomized hops and tilts during each shake, followed by a return to the authored resting positions

mobileWidthRevision.brief: On mobile devices make globe 90% of viewport vidth
mobileWidthRevision.heightLimitedFallback: Reduce width on short viewports to keep the complete globe and base in frame.

presentHeightRevision.brief: With each next shake presents should move higher, but not out of glass.

presentDriftRevision.brief: Presents should move like in vacuum, slowly.
presentDriftRevision.motion: One gradual rise and descent with a gentle tilt. New shakes blend from the current position.

waterRevision.brief: Synchronize gloab shaking and presents movement. Assume there is a water insie
waterRevision.motion: Globe rocking drives a damped sideways current while present lift peaks near the end of the shake.

landingRevision.brief: Presents should fall in random places after shaking, not the initial ones
landingRevision.motion: Each gift searches for a different landing spot in its region of the snow platform.
constraints: No overlap with other selected footprints

finaleRevision.brief: when presents reach the top of the glob 3 times, the random present goes through the glass, scaled (3x), and slowly rotate. Shaking is not available for globe at this state.
finaleRevision.trigger: Third distinct shake where at least one present reaches the glass ceiling
finaleRevision.result: One randomly chosen present leaves through the top, grows to 3× and rotates. Shake input is disabled until reload.

showcaseRevision.brief: After 3 seconds of selected product rotating, move the globe out off screen (down) and move this present to the center of the screen and scale it so it's 90% of screen width.
showcaseRevision.framing: Center the rotating silhouette and prioritize width on short viewports.

showcaseWidthRevision.brief: Make selected 50% of the viewport width on last step.

productRevealRevision.brief: If user cliks or tap on selected present, scale it down to 0 and show one random model from x-mass-presents directory instead. Then add confetti effect to the page instead of snow. Use should be able to rotate the final present model

retryRevision.brief: When User see his present, show "Retry" button at the top of the screen. White text, white border, opacity 70%. This button should reload the page.

finaleTriggerRevision.brief: Let's adjust a bit. Presents should reach the glass ones, not 3 times.

giftRotationRevision.brief: Next, make presents rotate in random directions while shaking and make the final present 50% of viewport.
giftRotationRevision.inGlobe: Each gift gets independent pitch, yaw and roll when the globe shakes.

productRotationRevision.brief: Use also should be able to rotate the final opened present in all directions
productRotationRevision.controls: Free mouse or touch drag and four arrow keys
